title: Slap in the Face Moment
next_chapter_hook: The instant the Xuanwu Sect Master fled in狼狈, Chen Ji received an urgent voice transmission from Mo Xiansheng—Su Qingyao had been kidnapped by mysterious forces, her whereabouts unknown. And the aura lingering on those mysterious forces was eerily similar to Chen Nian's, who had vanished long ago...

text.content: The Xuanwu Sect's cheers shook the heavens. Sect Master Han Batian stood atop the ruins with hands clasped behind his back, hair and beard bristling, pressure mountain-like. Behind him stretched countless disciples like a black tide. "Chen Ji is dead! The trash from Tianqing Sect dared to oppose Xuanwu Sect—this is the consequence!" His voice echoed through the valley, overflowing with arrogance. Yet deep within the ruins, a shadow almost merged with darkness watched it all. In Chen Ji's hand, the shattered Tianji Record Fragment pulsed with warmth, foresight flickering through his mind like a parade. His lips curved into a cold smile. "Han Batian, you think you're on the first level. In truth, you haven't even touched the chessboard."

Chen Ji slowly raised his right hand. In his palm, an almost invisible thread of fate trembled. It was the special ability granted by the Tianji Record—Fate Fragment Manipulation. He could precisely pluck those seemingly insignificant threads of karma, steering events toward his desired direction. The cost: each pluck consumed precious Heavenly Fate. But at this moment, he didn't care. "From the moment you decided to strike me, you entered my chessboard." He murmured, fingers flicking gently. The fate thread shot like an arrow into the distant void. Meanwhile, among the Xuanwu Sect ranks, an seemingly ordinary elder's eyes flickered with诡异 light.

Han Lie stood at the forefront. He was Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, the supreme commander of this raid. His cultivation had reached perfection, his fist intent capable of shattering mountains. But now, his brow creased slightly. "Father, something feels wrong." He murmured, "Chen Ji is cunning and treacherous. Dying so easily seems too convenient." Han Batian coldly snorted: "Lie'er, you're overthinking. So many eyes watched him blown to bits. Could it be fake? Besides—" Before he finished, his face suddenly changed drastically. For he noticed his trusted aide, the bodyguard who had followed him for decades, now gazing at him with a bizarre look. That gaze overflowed with scrutiny and... killing intent.

dialogue.content: "Sect Master, this subordinate has one question that puzzles me." The elder's voice was calm, yet its implications sent chills. Han Batian's pupils contracted: "Han Zhong, what do you mean?" The elder named Han Zhong slowly spoke: "Sect Master, this operation's intelligence came directly from 'that person.' But this subordinate wishes to know—who exactly is that person? Why were Xuanwu Sect's action plans so precisely calibrated to avoid all of Tianqing Sect's defenses? Unless... from the very beginning, this was a trap set for our Xuanwu Sect." At these words, chaos erupted. Disciples exchanged glances, whispers sprouting everywhere. Han Batian's expression turned murky as stagnant water.

text.content: Hidden in the shadows, Chen Ji's smile deepened. This was the first move in his chess game—Trust Fracture. The Tianji Record states every organization contains cracks. What he needed to do was amplify that crack. Han Zhong was Han Batian's confidant, but he had a fatal weakness: his son was held hostage by Han Batian to ensure loyalty. Chen Ji had long secretly arranged to rescue his son, letting Han Zhong know. On one side, coerced loyalty. On the other, his son's life and freedom. What would you choose? The answer was self-evident.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's eyes blazed, his fist轰向 Han Zhong: "Traitor! How dare you shake our morale!" Yet Han Zhong's form flickered, easily evading. His gaze at Han Lie brimmed with sorrow: "Young Sect Master, I sold my life for Xuanwu Sect for forty years. In the end, I couldn't even protect my own son—is this the Sect Master's trust?" Han Lie froze: "What do you mean?" Han Zhong's smile turned bitter: "Ask your good father where my son Han Qingyun is! Three days ago, he sent men to seize my son, imprisoning him in the sect's forbidden grounds, calling it 'protection.' If I don't die today, my son will surely die!" The Xuanwu Sect disciples' agitation intensified.

text.content: Han Batian's expression had reached its ugliest. Never would he have imagined his meticulously hidden secret would be exposed by a mere mole. At this moment, he realized an even more terrifying truth—how did this mole learn of this matter? The only explanation: someone deliberately leaked it to him! And this person... His gaze swept across the surroundings. Suddenly, a faint gaze met his. It was a pair of terrifyingly calm eyes, concealed within the ruins' shadows. Han Batian instantly understood, an icy chill surging from his feet to his crown. "Chen Ji... you truly aren't dead!"

In the ruins, Chen Ji slowly stepped out from the shadows. He still wore that shabby servant's attire, a faint smile on his face, as if merely taking a stroll. "Sect Master, long time no see." His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. Xuanwu Sect disciples instantly went on high alert, weapons drawn. Han Batian's face was ashen: "You dare show yourself! Aren't you afraid the old man will slay you on the spot?" Chen Ji chuckled lightly: "If the Sect Master had such ability, you wouldn't have been schemed against just now." He glanced around, finally landing on Han Zhong: "Elder Han, many thanks for your cooperation."

Han Zhong slightly bowed: "Master is too kind. If the master hadn't rescued my son from dire straits, Han Zhong would have been condemned as a ingrate for life." These words caused an uproar throughout Xuanwu Sect. So the so-called "traitor" was actually a chess piece turned by Chen Ji! And this piece had been embedded in Xuanwu Sect years ago! Han Batian felt his scalp go numb, unprecedented fear flooding his heart. When did this trash he viewed as an ant begin setting up such a game? How vast was his chess game?

choice.prompt: Facing the already panicking Han Batian, Chen Ji decided to deliver the final blow. At this moment, he could choose different ways to display his overwhelming dominance...

dialogue.content: "By the way, Sect Master, I haven't introduced myself yet." Chen Ji straightened his collar, taking out a token from his chest. "Tianqing Sect Shadow Division Executive, Chen Ji, pays respects to Xuanwu Sect Master." The token gleamed under the sunlight, nearly blinding Han Batian. "What?!" Han Batian gasped, "You're Shadow Division?!" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "I told you, I never put all my eggs in one basket. Tianqing Sect's trash servant was me. The Tianji Record inheritor was me. And the Shadow Division Executive... also me. You think you're on the second level. In truth, I'm in the stratosphere."

Han Lie's face twisted: "Chen Ji! I'll kill you!" He soared into the sky, fist intent crashing down on Chen Ji like a tempest. Yet Chen Ji merely sidestepped lightly. Those fist shadows grazed past him, not even touching his robe. "Young Sect Master Han, your fist technique is impressive. Unfortunately—" Chen Ji's voice was like a whisper from hell, "Too slow."

text.content: The instant Chen Ji finished speaking, his form vanished like a specter. The next moment, he appeared behind Han Lie, palm striking his back. "Bang!" Han Lie's body plummeted like a severed kite, creating a massive crater upon impact. He looked up in disbelief, blood trickling from his lips: "Your... your speed..." Chen Ji looked down at him: "I told you long ago, don't use your fists to test my bottom line."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took out a Jade Slip from his sleeve, casually tossing it to Han Batian. "Sect Master might as well examine this." The Jade Slip contained a recording—precisely the footage of Han Batian's transaction with a mysterious figure. That mysterious figure's aura was bizarre, clearly not of the righteous path. "Someone from the Demonic Path Holy Sect, Sect Master surely recognizes them?" Chen Ji's voice was calm as still water, yet thundered in everyone's ears. "You colluded with the Demonic Path, intending to use them as a blade while monopolizing the Tianji Record's secrets. Unfortunately, you don't know—that person... was also my chess piece."

text.content: Han Batian's face instantly turned deathly pale. The Xuanwu Sect disciples exploded—even more so—Sect Master colluding with the Demonic Path? This was an unforgivable crime in the cultivation world! "Nonsense!" Han Batian roared, "This is fabricated!" Chen Ji smiled lightly: "Fabricated? Then Sect Master explain why all the routes of this operation precisely avoided Tianqing Sect's every defense? Why did your vanguard get lost at a critical moment? Why did your forces arrive one hour earlier than scheduled,正好 running into our ambush?" Each question was like a knife, cruelly stabbing into Han Batian's heart.

Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, finally landing on those Xuanwu Sect disciples showing signs of wavering: "Everyone, you've all been deceived. Today's events, you are all witnesses. Xuanwu Sect Master colluded with the Demonic Path, harmed fellow cultivators—a crime unforgivable. And I, Tianqing Sect's Chen Ji—" His voice suddenly rose, "Execute Heaven's Judgment!" At this moment, he was no longer the ridiculed waste, but a chess master commanding the heavens! Xuanwu Sect disciples began to stir. Some had already quietly retreated, breaking ranks.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That laughter echoed through the ruins, sounding particularly jarring. "Sect Master, I nearly forgot one thing." He took out dozens of tokens from his chest, each carved with different clan insignias. "Recognize these? Spirit Medicine Pavilion, Artifact Refining Workshop, Spirit Stone Chamber of Commerce... That's right, these are all my industries. More precisely—" He tossed the tokens one by one to Han Batian, "These are documents severing cooperation with Xuanwu Sect. Starting today, thirty-six merchant guilds will completely terminate all trade with Xuanwu Sect."

text.content: Han Batian received those tokens. With each one he examined, his face grew paler. These merchant guilds covered ninety percent of Xuanwu Sect's resource supply! Once cooperation ends, Xuanwu Sect's tens of thousands of disciples will face the predicament of no Spirit Stones to use, no Elixirs to consume! "When... when did you..." His voice trembled. Chen Ji replied nonchalantly: "Three years ago, when I began arranging the Tianji Record inheritance, I was already working on this. Sect Master thought I was merely a fortune-telling waste? How laughable. From the moment you decided to strike me, you had already lost."

Xuanwu Sect disciples were utterly panicked. Economic severance meant what? It meant their cultivation resources would completely dry up! Some began cursing, some grew suspicious of their own people, and some had already quietly moved toward Chen Ji's direction, signaling willingness to surrender. Han Batian witnessed this scene, feeling the world spin around him. Forty years of painstakingly building his foundation, destroyed in a single day!

Chen Ji gazed at Han Batian's funeral-like appearance, his heart utterly unmoved. This was the consequence of opposing the Tianji Record inheritor. From the moment he decided to strike, the ending was already sealed. "Sect Master Han, I gave you a chance." Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried undeniable authority, "Three years ago, when you sent assassins after me, I could have chosen mutual destruction. But I didn't. I only wanted to see how high a跳梁小丑 could jump." His gaze swept across Han Lie, then across those Xuanwu Sect disciples with fear in their eyes, "Unfortunately, you disappointed me."

Han Batian suddenly let out a long roar toward the sky, his voice overflowing with madness and不甘: "Chen Ji! Don't be smug! Even if the old man loses today, my Xuanwu Sect's tens of thousands of disciples aren't something you can easily insult!" With that, he fiercely bit his tongue, spewing a mouthful of精血. His aura suddenly surged violently. This was Xuanwu Sect's forbidden technique—Blood Burning Great Method! Trading his own lifespan and cultivation for momentary peak battle power. "Today, even if the old man risks this old life, I'll drag you as a陪葬!" He howled, palms crushing down on Chen Ji like mountains.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed at that earth-shattering palm strike, yet the corner of his mouth lifted in mockery. "Blood Burning Great Method? An excellent forbidden technique. Unfortunately—" His voice suddenly turned ice-cold, "This is exactly what I was waiting for." The instant he finished, an ancient jade talisman appeared in his hand. Countless runes covered that jade talisman, emanating a chilling pressure. "Recognize this?" Chen Ji raised the jade talisman high, "Ancient Sealing Talisman, specifically designed to suppress blood-burning type forbidden techniques. You thought I hadn't calculated your trump card? How naive." The moment the talisman activated, a pillar of golden light shot skyward, completely shattering Han Batian's attack. Han Batian screamed, his body uncontrollably plummeting, crashing heavily to the ground, unable to rise again.

text.content: Xuanwu Sect disciples completely collapsed. Their Sect Master, Xuanwu Sect's number one expert, lay on the ground like a dead dog at this moment, utterly defenseless. And that once-ridiculed waste now gazed down at them like a deity. Chen Ji slowly descended, surveying his surroundings. His voice was calm yet clearly reached everyone's ears: "Today's matter ends here. I don't wish to create more bloodshed. You—" He paused, "Get lost. Go back and tell your sect elders that Xuanwu Sect's debt, I Chen Ji have noted. The next time we meet, it will be the day Xuanwu Sect is destroyed." That voice was calm, yet carried undeniable pressure, causing everyone to feel a bone-deep chill.

Xuanwu Sect's remnants retreated like a tide, leaving only a field of wreckage and the barely-breathing Han Batian lying on the ground. Han Lie was propped up by two elders, his eyes filled with不甘 and fear. He glared fiercely at Chen Ji, yet in that moment of eye contact, involuntarily looked away. Those eyes were too calm, calm enough to make him despair. Chen Ji watched their departing backs, a complex light flickering in his eyes. "Han Lie..." He murmured, "You and I are destined rivals, but today, I'm merely giving you a lesson. The next time we meet, it won't be so simple." He turned toward the ruins, a gentle light flickering in his eyes. "Tianji Record Chapter Seven Hundred and Four, Slap in the Face Moment, perfectly concluded." He spoke softly, lips slightly upturned. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Kid, you exposed too much. I've concealed the Tianji Record's aura for you, but next time... be careful." Chen Ji nodded: "I know. But some things must be done."

Just as Chen Ji prepared to leave, his expression suddenly changed. Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice transmission rang out: "Chen Ji, bad news! Su Qingyao has been kidnapped!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. An unprecedented killing intent exploded from his body. The surrounding air seemed to freeze. "What?!" His voice was low and dangerous, "Who did this?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "Based on my remaining perception, that aura... seems to be from the Demonic Path Holy Sect.
